decisions.statement: A shape is collected from every name format's code file the index names.
A shape is the pattern a regex literal reads as without its flags.
A regex literal is read from the parse rather than from the text.
A refusal names the line spelling the shape and the file stating that shape.
A name format spelling its own shape is passed over.
Two name formats stating one shape refuse neither name format.
A shape reached rather than spelled is nothing to read.

definition: the check refusing a regex spelling the shape a name format states
